tasks.title: Derive a project label from the encoded project directory name
tasks.dod: unit test proves an encoded path decodes to a readable path with the derived marker, and a non-path-like name falls back to itself with the same marker

tasks.title: Scan projects/ two levels deep and collect raw session records
tasks.dod: unit test on fixtures/claude-home proves the raw scan returns exactly the 6 session files (not the nested subagent transcript, not a session-level symlink) each with sessionId, project dir name, size and mtime read from disk

tasks.title: Deduplicate project-dir symlinks by realpath and reject external targets
tasks.dod: test on a disposable temp tree proves a symlink resolving outside CLAUDE_HOME contributes zero sessions and zero trace, and two symlinks resolving to the same inside directory contribute its sessions exactly once, in finite time

tasks.title: Sort sessions by mtime desc with filename tie-break and truncate to limit
tasks.dod: unit test proves sessions with distinct mtimes sort newest-first, two equal mtimes order by session filename, and a set above the limit is truncated with totalFound and truncated reflecting the pre-truncation count

tasks.title: Make the scan best-effort: skip unreadable entries, count them, never throw
tasks.dod: test with an unreadable projects dir, an unreadable project subdir and an unreadable session file each proves listSessions() returns 200-equivalent data (sessions from what did read, unreadableCount for what did not) instead of throwing; a before/after directory snapshot of CLAUDE_HOME proves zero writes; a timed run on fixtures/claude-home proves the pure function completes in <=50ms

tasks.title: Wire GET / to read, validate and pass through the ?limit query param
tasks.dod: test proves an invalid ?limit (non-numeric, zero, negative, above 1000) falls back to the default 50 with an explanatory note instead of failing the request, a valid ?limit is forwarded to listSessions(), and /api/health plus the page CSP are byte-identical to before this feature

tasks.title: Render the session index table, empty state and notes
tasks.dod: integration test through startServer() proves the rendered page lists every fixture session with project label, id, human-readable size (exact bytes in title), absolute mtime, shows empty() when there are no sessions, shows the invalid-limit / truncated / unreadable notes when present, and never contains a fragment of conversation text
